semantics.definition: A maintained familiar place suspended between expected passage and destination use: route or service cues remain, yet occupancy, active function, and temporal context are conspicuously missing or slightly displaced. Emptiness, darkness, decay, yellow corridors, or horror imagery alone do not establish liminality.

a maintained pool passage still carries route and changing-area cues after every expected use has paused
repeating doors and ceiling bays lead toward an unresolved destination in a clean between-use concourse
